node.title: Re: LWP::UserAgent Alternatives for API data
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[mod://LWP::UserAgent] is extremely well established, so yes, you could just stick with that if you figure out the correct options*. Other than that, I'd recommend [mod://HTTP::Tiny], or, if you want to step it up a bit, [mod://Mojo::UserAgent], which has the advantage that it gives you easy access to JSON and XML/HTML parsing features via [mod://Mojo::JSON] ($ua->get($url)->result->json) and [mod://Mojo::DOM] ($ua->get($url)->result->dom).

* LWP is not my area of expertise, and you also don't say exactly in which way the requests are going wrong ([id://1177642|SSCCE], [id://174051]). Tracing a good request and comparing with a bad one using [http://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark] might be very useful here.
